[[File:Firefly Flare.png|250px|thumb|The '''Firefly Flare''']]

A bright flare that pushes back the darkness of the abyssal depths. Firefly flares fuse with nearby flares to increase their timer.

The '''Firefly Flare''' is a consumable item used to keep the player alive within the {{Abyssal Depth}}. Each flare lasts for 10 minutes.

== Obtainment ==
[[File:Crafting Table.png|250px|thumb|''The Crafting Table'']]
* Use a [[Minerals#Legendary|Firefly Stone]] on the crafting table near the entrance to the Abyss. 
* 1 Firefly Stone will yield 1 Firefly Flare.

== Usage ==
* Using the Firefly Flare will cause the player to throw it in the direction they are facing. 
* Each flare will last for 10 minutes.
* Flares will fuse with other nearby flares to increase their remaining timer.
